frontmatter.description: Audits, detects gaps, and remediates Android permissions and IPC component security vulnerabilities. Use when reviewing AndroidManifest.xml, defining custom permissions, securing Services, Receivers, and Providers, verifying caller signatures and UID using Binder, or implementing runtime permission flows.
